newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia's Wallis inquiry release timetable.
newsitem.headline: Australia's Wallis inquiry release timetable.

text.p: The Wallis inquiry into Australia's financial system would be publicly released after a news conference by Treasurer Peter Costello in Canberra at 12 midday (0200 GMT), his office said on Wednesday.
Inquiry Chairman Stan Wallis would hold a news conference in Canberra at 2.00 p.m (0400 GMT), Costello's office said in a statement.
Copies of the report would also be publicly available from about 12 midday (0200 GMT) at commonwealth government bookshops, it said.
The report would also be available on the internet from the financial inquiry secretariat home page at the time of release on the following address: http://www.treasury.gov.au/fsi/.
Limited numbers of copies would also be available for interstate media from Treasury offices in Melbourne and Sydney.
The five-person inquiry was set up in June last year and has received 268 submissions from the financial sector's main players about various options for reform.
The government is expected to respond to some parts of the report.
The inquiry is widely expected to recommend the government ease rules currently stopping Australia's major banks from merging with each other.
